hero_description: A high-contrast, energy-driven editorial shoot for an underground speakeasy menu. We focused on capturing the raw, tactile essence of mixology—shattered ice, spilled bitters, and intense neon rim lighting. The goal was to make the drinks feel like aggressive pieces of modern art.
hero_main_image_alt: A vivid orange cocktail splash in a crystal glass.
hero_polaroid_alt: Black and white bartender close-up polaroid.
hero_accent_alt: Electric blue cocktail as supporting visual.
